_ordering_rationale: Part datacenters dans ventes électricité Virginia + comptes clients sont les KPI distinctifs Dominion (story PJM/AI). Complètent Virginia Revenue et Data Center Load déjà présents.

kpis.name_en: Data Center Share of Virginia Power Sales
kpis.signal: Part datacenters >25% des ventes Virginia, croissance structurelle PJM Data Center Alley

kpis.description_en: Share of Virginia Power electricity sales consumed by data centers. Up from 21% in 2022 to 26% in 2024. Data Center Alley region (Loudoun County) booming with AI demand.

kpis.signal: Croissance régulière des comptes (~30k/an), base solide pour récupération CAPEX via rider

kpis.description_en: Number of customer accounts at Virginia Electric and Power Company (DEV), Dominion main subsidiary. Steady ~1% annual growth, favorable Virginia/North Carolina demographics.
